convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 standard library classes (CExpert, CSignalMA, CTrailingNone, CMoneyFixedLot) wrapping the built-in iMA indicator. Simple MA crossover entry/exit with fixed lot sizing. No custom indicators, no external .mqh libraries containing trading logic, no complex money management.
custom_logic_notes: This EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework (CExpert). The CSignalMA class implements a single Moving Average signal where price crossing above the MA generates a buy signal and price crossing below generates a sell signal. The CExpert base class handles position management internally: it closes opposite positions before opening new ones (reverse on signal change), and checks for existing positions/margin before entry. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA processes signals only once per bar (on bar open), not on every tick. No explicit SL/TP is set; exits occur only on signal reversal. The CMoneyFixedLot uses a fixed lot size of 0.1 lots with a 10% margin percent parameter.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. The CSignalMA logic is a simple price-vs-MA crossover: go long when close[1] > MA[1] and close[2] <= MA[2], go short when close[1] < MA[1] and close[2] >= MA[2]. Use pandas TA or ta-lib for the SMA calculation. Position sizing is fixed at 0.1 lots. No SL/TP — exits are signal-reversal only (close opposite on new signal). The new_bar_guard (Expert_EveryTick=false) means evaluate only on new bar formation, which maps to resampling OHLC data and evaluating at each new bar. The standard library .mqh files are framework boilerplate, not custom trading logic, so no manual conversion of those is needed.
